_schema.purpose: Pin XChaCha20-Poly1305 seal/open with explicit AAD so two implementations interoperate.

format.vectors[].name: Human label.
format.vectors[].key: base64url-no-pad of the 32-byte AEAD key (either eventKey or snapshotKey, see `keyKind`).
format.vectors[].plaintext: base64url-no-pad of the plaintext bytes (typically canonical JSON of a ReviewEvent or snapshot bytes).
format.vectors[].aad: base64url-no-pad of the associated-data bytes (canonical JSON of envelope metadata block — see spec).
format.vectors[].expected.ciphertext: base64url-no-pad of the AEAD output (ciphertext || 16-byte Poly1305 tag, per RustCrypto convention).
format.vectors[].expected.aadAsJson: Optional convenience: the UTF-8 JSON view of `aad` for human inspection.
